title: RecordAttachmentsPanel renders "No attachments yet" for a network/5xx failure it never loaded
body:
## Finding

Found while implementing #4269 (a 403 attachment list rendered as the empty state). That card's ruling scoped the fix to the **denied-vs-empty** distinction and explicitly left non-authorization failures at their current handling, so this is filed rather than fixed there.

`RecordAttachmentsPanel.refresh()` catches **every** failed `sys_attachment` list read and falls back to `setRows([])`. After #4269 the authorization branch is split out, but everything else still lands in the empty state:

- a network failure (server unreachable, DNS, aborted request)
- a 5xx
- a 401 (`AUTH_REQUIRED` — session expired), which is authentication, not authorization, so the denied predicate deliberately does not claim it

All three render **"No attachments yet. Upload a file to get started."** — an affirmative assertion that the record holds nothing, made by a panel that never got an answer. It is the same defect class as #4269, one status over: the panel states as fact something it does not know.

## Why it is a real defect, not polish

The house rule already exists elsewhere in this repo and was landed twice as a bug fix:

- `HomeActionCenter` (#4235): "You're all caught up" is an ASSERTION about the inbox, so it may only be made once the inbox has answered — an unanswered read renders a quiet notice instead.
- The app list (#4300): "an unloadable app list is UNKNOWN, not 'no default app'".
- `ListView.classifyLoadError` carries the full five-way vocabulary (`api-disabled` / `forbidden` / `unauthorized` / `rejected` / `network`).

The attachments panel is the surface that still lacks it.

## Suggested shape

Give the panel the same status vocabulary the siblings use — `loading` / `loaded` / `denied` / `unavailable` — and reserve the empty state for a genuine 200-with-zero-rows. A failed-to-load state should say the list could not be loaded (and, unlike the denied state, may keep a retry).

Note that #4269's test file already pins TODAY's behaviour for a non-authz failure (`pins today's behaviour for a NON-authz failure: still the empty state`), deliberately, so that changing it is a conscious edit rather than an accident. That test is the one to rewrite when this is picked up.

## Scope note

Touches the same `catch` block as #4269, so it is best sequenced after that PR lands. #4269 is not addressed by this issue and remains open on its own.

File: `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`

Filed unassigned from the #4269 dispatch, for PM triage.
